entries.message: This update includes make Up Next reliable across Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin and verify the public documentation against the v1.1.0 release.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Add a Main / Alpha toggle to Settings - Changelog, explained in the in-app Release Guide, so any install can read published alpha build notes
Tweak: This update includes make Up Next reliable across Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin and verify the public documentation against the v1.1.0 release.
Tweak: Show the right next episode even when it has never been watched, so an episode sitting unwatched in your libraries no longer goes missing from Up Next
Tweak: Return an episode to Up Next when you mark it unwatched, instead of dropping it from the queue
Tweak: Mirror Up Next onto Plex Continue Watching, Emby Resume, and Jellyfin Resume so the same queue appears on your media server's own rails
Tweak: Share Up Next dismissals across every device and browser, and add a dialog to review and restore anything dismissed by mistake
Tweak: Restore Jellyfin as a full Up Next source for reading, dismissing, playlists, and rails
Tweak: Stop an Up Next push from reaching the wrong title on a media server that reuses short numeric ids
Tweak: Tell alpha and develop installs about a newer build on their own channel as well as a newer published release, and publish changelog bullets in full instead of cutting them off mid-sentence
Tweak: Mark all 36 documentation pages as verified against the v1.1.0 application baseline, replacing markers that still claimed v1.0.2 while v1.1.0 was live
Tweak: Show the release changelog, the documentation state, and the running application and website before a release is published, so the exact state being released can be checked first
